philosophy.title: Stylesheets are architecture
philosophy.body: A resilient stylesheet survives the next six people who touch it. That is a design decision, not a cleanup task.

philosophy.title: Accessibility is the baseline
philosophy.body: WCAG is where a build starts, not an audit that happens near launch.

philosophy.title: Motion carries meaning
philosophy.body: Animation should explain what changed. If it cannot be turned off gracefully, it was not finished.

intro: I came to the web through graphic design. A BFA at Missouri State, then years of print and identity work, before the browser became the more interesting canvas. That order matters: I still think about a page as a composition first and a component tree second.

Since 2016 I have led front-end at Marlin Connections, building user-facing features for products in the food-service industry and keeping the technical and the experiential in the same conversation. Before that, agency work, in-house design, and eight semesters teaching design students at Missouri State, from software fundamentals to advanced web coding.
Teaching changed how I write code. If you cannot explain a stylesheet to a sophomore, it is probably not a good stylesheet.

education.degree: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Graphic Design, Cum Laude

jobs.role: Senior Web Developer and Front-end Team Leader
jobs.body: Using front-end web technologies to develop user-facing features for new and existing web-based products in the food-service industry. Working with designers and other developers to ensure technical feasibility while maintaining user-experience and application architecture best practices.

Instructed five courses for design students from sophomores to seniors. Topics included an introduction to design software, various aspects of production, communication concepts in graphic design, and basic and advanced web design concepts and coding. All courses were structured around hands-on projects.

Created and maintained a variety of print and web design projects for local and regional clients in a wide range of industries. Managed the design and development of websites from concept to completion, as well as the hosting and maintenance of those websites.
